description: Number of Hospitals and Health Units by Sector is a data set listed in Bahrain Open Data Portal (data.gov.bh), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Health Regulating Authority. The total number of operational and licensed hospitals and health units, classified by public or private sector, during a specified year. Sources: For the years 2015-2019: Information and Planning Directorate / Ministry of Health For the years 2020-2024: National Health Regulating Authority (NHRA). Coverage: Bahrain. The portal files it under the publisher National Health Regulating Authority. Its tags are Health, Hospitals, NHRA. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support health-facility access and emergency-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
